summary: Master Quantity Surveying and Cost Estimation with hands-on BOQ, EVM, and rate analysis. Build defensible budgets and control project spend.
lede: Quantity surveying training covers measuring construction work and estimating, documenting and controlling project costs. It is for quantity surveyors, cost managers, project controllers and construction managers who need to prepare cost information and monitor spending from planning through closeout. Learners practice quantifying work, developing estimates and bills of quantities, analyzing rates, forecasting cash flow, applying earned value measures, and managing variations and interim payment applications.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior practitioners and managers who must deliver accurate cost governance in construction, infrastructure, and real estate projects.
audience: Cost Manager – Forecast cash flow, run
Project Controller – Track Earned Value metrics
Estimation Engineer – Develop bottom-up and parametric
Cost Engineer – Analyze rates for labor
Infrastructure Project Manager – Anticipate time-cost risks
modules: Foundations of Quantity Surveying and Cost Estimation
Work Breakdown Structure and Schedule Development
Cost Estimation Techniques and Rate Analysis
Bills of Quantities and Schedule of Rates
Earned Value Management and Cost Control
Variations, Claims, and Interim Payment Management
Cash Flow Forecasting and Project Closeout
Digital Tools and AI in Quantity Surveying
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of construction components (earthwork, concrete, steel, finishing), basic arithmetic for volume/area calculations, and familiarity with Excel. No coding required. Participants should bring a laptop with Excel and MS Project (or equivalent) installed. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level—you will commission and consume cost models, not engineer them from scratch.
